post.caption: The diamond anniversary is the 60th. Silver marks the 25th year and gold marks the 50th, and some lists also give diamond to the 75th. Silver and gold anniversaries are traced to German-speaking lands, where couples were given a silver wreath, then later a gold one. In 1937, an American jewelers' association introduced an expanded list. Pearl is for the 30th and ruby for the 40th. Queen Victoria's Diamond Jubilee in 1897 marked 60 years on the throne, and platinum marks the 70th year in the British list. The Queen and Prince Philip marked a platinum anniversary in 2017.
